            cells = [(r+i,c) for i in range(L)]

def policy(board):
    # compute unknown cells and hits
    unknowns = []
    hits = []
    for r in range(10):
        for c in range(10):
            val = board[r][c]
            if val == 0:
                unknowns.append((r,c))
            elif val == 1:
                hits.append((r,c))
    # compute scores for each unknown cell based on valid ship placements
    score = {}
    for cells in PLACEMENTS:
        # check if placement conflicts with any miss
        valid = True
        for (r,c) in cells:
            if board[r][c] == -1:
                valid = False
                break
        if valid:
            for (r,c) in cells:
                if board[r][c] == 0:
                    score[(r,c)] = score.get((r,c), 0) + 1

    # If we have hits, attempt target mode
    if hits:
        # find clusters of hits
        clusters = []
        visited = set()
        for start in hits:
            if start in visited:
                continue
            # BFS
            stack = [start]
            cluster = []
            while stack:
                r,c = stack.pop()
                if (r,c) in visited:
                    continue
                visited.add((r,c))
                cluster.append((r,c))
                for dr,dc in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                    nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
                    if 0 <= nr < 10 and 0 <= nc < 10 and board[nr][nc] == 1 and (nr,nc) not in visited:
                        stack.append((nr,nc))
            clusters.append(cluster)

        candidate_targets = []
        for cluster in clusters:

                r,c = cluster[0]
                # 4 neighbours
                for dr,dc in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                    nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
                    if 0 <= nr < 10 and 0 <= nc < 10 and board[nr][nc] == 0:
                        candidate_targets.append((nr,nc))
            else:
                rows = {r for r,_ in cluster}
                cols = {c for _,c in cluster}
                if len(rows) == 1:
                    # horizontal
                    r = rows.pop()
                    cols_sorted = sorted([c for _,c in cluster])
                    min_c, max_c = cols_sorted[0], cols_sorted[-1]
                    # left end
                    if min_c > 0 and board[r][min_c-1] == 0:
                        candidate_targets.append((r, min_c-1))
                    # right end
                    if max_c < 9 and board[r][max_c+1] == 0:
                        candidate_targets.append((r, max_c+1))
                elif len(cols) == 1:

                    rows_sorted = sorted([r for r,_ in cluster])
                    min_r, max_r = rows_sorted[0], rows_sorted[-1]
                    if min_r > 0 and board[min_r-1][c] == 0:
                        candidate_targets.append((min_r-1, c))
                    if max_r < 9 and board[max_r+1][c] == 0:

                else:

                            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
                            if 0 <= nr < 10 and 0 <= nc < 10 and board[nr][nc] == 0:
                                candidate_targets.append((nr,nc))

        # Remove duplicates

        if candidate_targets:

                    best = cell
                    candidates_with_max = [cell]
                elif s == max_s:

            return random.choice(candidates_with_max)

    # Hunt mode: choose unknown cell with highest score

    return random.choice(candidates_with_max)
